newsitem.title: USA: Estimated mutual fund inflows rose in July--ICI.
newsitem.headline: Estimated mutual fund inflows rose in July--ICI.

text.p: The Investment Company Institute said Thursday it estimates net new cash flows to long-term mutual funds rose to $27.0 billion in July from an actual level of $18.7 billion in June.
The institute, a national association of the mutual fund industry, said estimated flows to stock funds rose to $23.0 billion in July from a $16.6 billion actual level in June.
Inflows to bond and income funds rose to an estimated $4.0 billion in July from an actual $2.1 billion in June, it said.

The monthly estimates, which are released two to three weeks before actual data are reported, are drawn from unpublished weekly estimates based on a survey of long-term funds that account for about 97 percent of long-term mutual fund assets and are reported to the nearest $500 million.
